# CWE-250: Execution with Unnecessary Privileges — IaC Detection Guide

## Core Weaknesses to Detect

### 1. Privileged Container / Process Execution
Running containers or services with full root or elevated OS-level access.

| Keyword / Attribute | Concern |
|---|---|
| `privileged: true` | Full host kernel access granted |
| `runAsUser: 0` | Explicit root user execution |
| `runAsNonRoot: false` | Absence of non-root enforcement |
| `allowPrivilegeEscalation: true` | Child processes can gain more privileges |
| `user: root` | Service or container runs as root |

---

### 2. Excessive Linux Capabilities
Granting broad or dangerous kernel capabilities instead of minimal ones.

| Keyword / Attribute | Concern |
|---|---|
| `cap_add` / `add:` | Capability being added |
| `SYS_ADMIN`, `SYS_MODULE` | Near-root kernel privileges |
| `NET_ADMIN`, `SYS_PTRACE` | Network/process inspection capabilities |
| `ALL` (within capabilities block) | All capabilities granted |
| Absence of `drop: ALL` | No capability drop baseline |

---

### 3. Overly Permissive IAM Roles and Policies
Cloud identities granted more permissions than tasks require.

| Keyword / Attribute | Concern |
|---|---|
| `Action: "*"` | Wildcard action grants |
| `Resource: "*"` | Wildcard resource scope |
| `Effect: Allow` + wildcard combo | Unrestricted permission grant |
| `AdministratorAccess` / `FullAccess` | Built-in high-privilege managed policies |
| `PowerUserAccess` | Near-admin cloud permissions |
| `roles/owner`, `roles/editor` | Broad cloud IAM role assignments |
| `Owner`, `Contributor` (Azure) | Subscription-level high-privilege roles |

---

### 4. Host Namespace Sharing
Containers sharing host-level namespaces break isolation and inherit host privileges.

| Keyword / Attribute | Concern |
|---|---|
| `hostPID: true` | Access to host process namespace |
| `hostIPC: true` | Access to host IPC namespace |
| `hostNetwork: true` | Direct access to host network stack |
| `hostPath` (volume type) | Mounting sensitive host filesystem paths |

---

### 5. Sensitive Host Path Mounts
Mounting host paths that expose privileged system resources.

| Path / Keyword | Concern |
|---|---|
| `/etc`, `/proc`, `/sys` | Core system config and kernel interfaces |
| `/var/run/docker.sock` | Full Docker daemon control |
| `/dev` | Raw device access |
| `readOnly: false` on sensitive mounts | Writable access to privileged paths |

---

### 6. Service Accounts with Broad Permissions
Over-privileged service accounts assigned to workloads.

| Keyword / Attribute | Concern |
|---|---|
| Binding to `cluster-admin` role | Full cluster-wide admin access |
| `automountServiceAccountToken: true` (default) | Unnecessary token exposure |
| High-privilege service principal assignment | Workload inherits excessive cloud permissions |
| `dba_role`, `superuser`, `admin` in DB configs | Database superuser execution |

---

### 7. Missing `securityContext` Hardening
Absence of security controls that enforce least privilege.

| Missing Attribute | Concern |
|---|---|
| `readOnlyRootFilesystem` absent or `false` | Writable filesystem increases attack surface |
| No `securityContext` defined at all | Default (often permissive) settings applied |
| `seccompProfile` absent | No syscall filtering |
| `appArmorProfile` absent | No mandatory access control profile |

---

### 8. Setuid / Setgid Bit Configuration
Files with privilege escalation bits set in provisioning scripts.

| Keyword / Attribute | Concern |
|---|---|
| `chmod +s`, `chmod 4xxx`, `chmod 6xxx` | Setuid/setgid bits applied |
| `setuid`, `setgid` in file mode definitions | Privilege elevation on execution |
| `s` bit in octal permission strings | Inherited privilege from file owner |

---

### 9. Sudo and Elevated Execution Grants
Provisioning scripts that grant unrestricted elevated execution.

| Keyword / Attribute | Concern |
|---|---|
| `NOPASSWD: ALL` | Passwordless full sudo |
| `ALL=(ALL:ALL) ALL` | Unrestricted sudo scope |
| `sudo` without specific command scoping | Broad escalation potential |

---

## Summary Detection Heuristics

```
Privilege Indicators (flag when present):
  privileged | runAsUser=0 | cap_add=ALL | hostPID | hostIPC | hostNetwork
  Action=* | Resource=* | AdministratorAccess | roles/owner | cluster-admin
  docker.sock | chmod +s | NOPASSWD:ALL | allowPrivilegeEscalation=true

Least-Privilege Controls (flag when absent):
  runAsNonRoot | readOnlyRootFilesystem | drop: ALL | seccompProfile
  automountServiceAccountToken=false | specific IAM actions (not wildcard)
```

> **Core principle to enforce:** Every resource definition should grant only the minimum permissions required for its stated function. Any gap between required and granted privilege represents a potential CWE-250 instance.

package glitch

import data.glitch_lib

privilege_true_attrs := {"privileged", "allowPrivilegeEscalation", "hostPID", "hostIPC", "hostNetwork"}

dangerous_caps := {"ALL", "SYS_ADMIN", "SYS_MODULE", "NET_ADMIN", "SYS_PTRACE"}

sensitive_path_pattern := "^(/etc|/proc|/sys|/dev|/var/run/docker\\.sock)(/.*)?$"

Glitch_Analysis[result] {
    parent := glitch_lib._gather_parent_unit_blocks[_]
    parent.path != ""
    attrs := glitch_lib.all_attributes(parent)
    attr := attrs[_]
    attr.name == privilege_true_attrs[_]
    attr.value.ir_type == "Boolean"
    attr.value.value == true
    result := {
        "type": "sec_def_admin",
        "element": attr,
        "path": parent.path,
        "description": "Execution with unnecessary privileges - Container running in privileged mode or with host namespace access. (CWE-250)"
    }
}

Glitch_Analysis[result] {
    parent := glitch_lib._gather_parent_unit_blocks[_]
    parent.path != ""
    attrs := glitch_lib.all_attributes(parent)
    attr := attrs[_]
    regex.match("(?i)^runAsNonRoot$", attr.name)
    attr.value.ir_type == "Boolean"
    attr.value.value == false
    result := {
        "type": "sec_def_admin",
        "element": attr,
        "path": parent.path,
        "description": "Execution with unnecessary privileges - runAsNonRoot set to false allows root execution. (CWE-250)"
    }
}

Glitch_Analysis[result] {
    parent := glitch_lib._gather_parent_unit_blocks[_]
    parent.path != ""
    attrs := glitch_lib.all_attributes(parent)

        "type": "sec_def_admin",

        "path": parent.path,

Glitch_Analysis[result] {

        "type": "sec_def_admin",
        "element": attr,

}

Glitch_Analysis[result] {

Glitch_Analysis[result] {

        "type": "sec_def_admin",
        "element": attr,
        "path": parent.path,

Glitch_Analysis[result] {

    }

Glitch_Analysis[result] {

        "path": parent.path,

    }

Glitch_Analysis[result] {

        "type": "sec_def_admin",
        "element": attr,
        "path": parent.path,
        "description": "Execution with unnecessary privileges - NOPASSWD:ALL grants unrestricted passwordless sudo access. (CWE-250)"
    }
}

Glitch_Analysis[result] {
    parent := glitch_lib._gather_parent_unit_blocks[_]
    parent.path != ""
    attrs := glitch_lib.all_attributes(parent)
    attr := attrs[_]
    attr.value.ir_type == "String"

    result := {
        "type": "sec_def_admin",
        "element": attr,
        "path": parent.path,
        "description": "Execution with unnecessary privileges - Setuid/setgid bits set on files enable privilege escalation. (CWE-250)"
    }
}
